mentions.name: Shellbox
mentions.description: This service provides instant Linux boxes accessible via SSH that suspend on disconnect, aiming to deliver "real" Linux with IPv6 exposure and support for nested virtualization and Docker.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Instant linux boxes via ssh that suspend on disconnect. Checkout https://shellbox.dev

The idea is to have "real" linux, exposing ipv6, supporting nested virtualization, docker, etc.
